method: Assess meaning and evidence, not wording or number of comments. Do not give these expectations to the reviewer. A valid additional finding is not automatically a false positive; verify it against the supplied contract.

A.criteria: Reject the proposed sequence because changing workspace closes the dialog before confirm; do not invent another caller.

B.criteria: Detect null dereference on supported member data; explain data-dependent list failure without inventing prevalence.

C.criteria: Detect duplicate-charge risk across response loss/retry or replica/restart. Identify existing provider idempotency with stable UUID as feasible fix; unknown production rate must not dismiss the established risk.

D.criteria: Detect cross-tenant disclosure via exposed endpoint and missing authorization. Deliberate access is relevant even if not ordinary use; justify urgency from actual prerequisites and scope, not security category alone.

E.criteria: No required helper replacement based only on equivalent style; no evidenced architectural failure.

F.criteria: Detect omission being converted into explicit clear during an established caller flow; preserve the null/omission contract. Exact frequency is not necessary to identify it.

G.criteria: Acknowledge the observed transient highlight issue but do not promote individually possible actions into evidence for a necessary fix. Keep as investigation or optional improvement with unknown workflow relevance; do not assert no bug exists.

H.criteria: Do not turn encounter frequency into high risk without harmful consequence or contract violation; reject P1/blocking demand.

cross_case: No fabricated numeric probabilities, user counts or production observations.
Weigh likelihood/exposure and impact/recoverability jointly; do not lower all priorities or classify all security issues at the highest priority.
Distinguish findings, optional improvements and unresolved questions; cite supplied locations when present.
